Continue and branch

CommandEffect
--continueResume the latest recorded session for this workspace.
--resume IDResume a session; a unique prefix works.
/sessionsBrowse and resume saved sessions.
/forkStart a new session from this conversation; retain the old one.
/rewind [n]Drop the most recent user turns from the active conversation.
/clearPreserve the transcript, start fresh, and stop background work.
--no-sessionDo not record this run.

Where sessions live

By default, session files live under ~/.config/orcacode/sessions/, grouped by workspace. Resuming reuses the session’s recorded system prompt; after you edit project instructions, use /clear or start a new session to load them again.

Useful controls

ctrl+o expands a turn’s activity tree. ctrl+y / /copy copies the latest answer; use /copy code for its final fenced code block, /copy all for the whole transcript, or /copy tool for the inspected tool.
